qualification: Recorded sequential research selections. Camera 2022 was already seen in earlier research; none is an untouched holdout.

initial.rationale: Bounded pair scale 1.5 reduces municipal and college extreme/tail error frequencies with college coverage close to the old model, improved proper scores and mean error. Strata Beta scale 1 offers higher coverage as the main alternative. Both remain candidates; later-election and full-domain validation may reject, not retune, them.
initial.selectionData: Eight Camera 2013/2018 horizon cases, equal units; no Camera 2022 output inspected.

mass.reason: Scale 1.5 gives the best coverage of the predeclared mass-weighted grid while reducing severe tail errors against the original model. Mass-weighted matching addresses the demonstrated component-count/major-party underdispersion defect; do not retune this scale on reused Camera 2022 validation. The strata Beta alternative is retained for comparison.

regional.rationale: Select rho .25 on 8 development cases: municipal error30 .04208 vs .04196 for .5 is effectively unchanged; college error30 .02980 vs .03162, WIS .03324 vs .03337 and near-truth .2071 vs .2033 favour .25; coverage .8711 vs .8754 captures most shared-geography gain over rho0 .8558. Reused 2022 validation has not been inspected for these regional variants; not an untouched holdout.
